name: GLOBAL MODULATION SENSITIVITY

precommitted_interpretation.sensitivity: A deterministic difference from REFERENCE is computational parameter sensitivity.
precommitted_interpretation.no_effect: No deterministic difference from REFERENCE is a valid null result.
precommitted_interpretation.nonlinear_change: Non-monotonic or asymmetric responses are reported descriptively unless separately preregistered.

explicit_exclusions: No biological neuromodulator identity is assigned.
No dopamine, serotonin, octopamine, hormone, or receptor claim.
No broker, WARDEN-01, or Sugar Cube test.
No financial semantics or profitability claim.
No change to MQ-9 roadmap state.
claim_boundary: SQ-04 measures deterministic sensitivity of the frozen MoscaQuant computational runtime to small global changes in spike threshold and membrane time constant. These parameters are model mechanics. The experiment does not identify or simulate a biological neuromodulatory system, establish biological realism, test learning, or demonstrate financial usefulness.
